curveGeneration.direction: seeded pseudo-random; consecutive alternation intentionally avoided; fixed seed makes runs/replays reproducible
curveGeneration.transitionModel: curvature ramps from 0 to 1/R and back over transition sections; radius varies progressively rather than hard switching

gradientModel: sum of two low-frequency sine waves, direction-aware; fictional game-only placeholder
speedModel: varied section speeds with station approach caps and curve-radius caps; verify with braking-distance and signal logic before treating as final gameplay data
disclaimer: Synthetic route geometry only. Not surveyed, not a real railway, and not safe for real-world operating use.
